extDescription.message: Fill login forms from your mVault records and offer to save new logins.

invalidAddress.message: Enter a valid http(s) mVault address without credentials or query parameters.

permissionDenied.message: Allow access to your mVault address to connect.

reconnect.message: Reconnect to grant access to this mVault address.

openWebsite.message: Open a website to fill first.

siteOnly.message: Autofill is available on websites only.

signIn.message: mVault opened in another tab. Sign in there, then click the extension again.

signInRetry.message: Sign in to mVault in its browser tab, then try again.

noMatches.message: No password record matches this exact hostname.

refreshVault.message: Refresh the signed-in mVault tab, then try again.

filledPassword.message: Password filled. No username field was found.

memberAccount.message: Sign in with a member account; administrator accounts cannot access vault records.

missingApi.message: This mVault server does not have the extension API yet. Update the mVault app, then try again.

autoHint.message: Needs access to all websites. Nothing is filled until you click, and saving always asks first.

optSuggest.message: Suggest matching logins on login pages

autoDenied.message: Allow access to websites to turn this on.

badgeSignIn.message: mVault: sign in to see matching logins

noProjects.message: Create a password project in mVault first to save logins.
